Your holdings: SOXL (-50.57%) and SPAL (-34.91%) are your biggest headaches, both leveraged ETFs decaying fast. QQQI (-3.29%) also needs a trim. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on NVDA, which has an "ACCUMULATE" scanner signal today, and ASML, another chip name on watch.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged losses and staying disciplined with stops in this uncertain market.
plays: SOXL: Your -50.57% loss is critical. Respect the 200 stop or consider cutting this leveraged position.
SPAL: Down -34.91%, this leveraged ETF needs attention. Re-evaluate your 21.38 stop or reduce exposure.
NVDA: Scanner shows "ACCUMULATE." Consider a small entry around 223.94-223.71 with a stop at 223.16 for chip exposure.
